_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج قاموس هيكل تجزئة العمل هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع.

Work package name.guidance: Enter a brief description of the work package deliverable from the WBS.

Code of account.guidance: Enter the code of account from the WBS.

Milestones.guidance: List any milestones associated with the work package.

Due dates.guidance: List the due dates for milestones associated with the work package.

ID.guidance: Enter a unique activity identifier—usually an extension of the WBS code of accounts.

Activity.guidance: Describe the activity from the activity list or the schedule.

Team resource.guidance: Identify the resources, usually from the resource requirements.

Labor rate.guidance: Enter the labor rate, usually from cost estimates.

Labor total.guidance: Multiply the effort hours times the labor rate.

Material units.guidance: Enter the amount of material required, usually from the resource requirements.

Material cost.guidance: Enter the material cost, usually from cost estimates.

Material total.guidance: Multiply the material units times the material cost.

Total cost.guidance: Sum the labor, materials, and any other costs associated with the work package.

Quality requirements.guidance: Document any quality requirements or metrics associated with the work package.

Acceptance criteria.guidance: Describe the acceptance criteria for the deliverable, usually from the scope statement.

Technical information.guidance: Describe or reference any technical requirements or documentation needed to complete the work package.

Agreement information.guidance: Reference any contracts or other agreements that impact the work package.
